panels.title: Total Transactions
panels.description: Total transactions within selected time range

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM transactions WHERE status='flagged' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='flagged')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) * 100, 2), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(risk_score)::NUMERIC, 3), 0) AS value FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)

panels.title: Transaction Volume per Minute
panels.description: Total vs flagged transactions over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS total_transactions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status='flagged') AS flagged_transactions FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS time, ROUND(AVG(risk_score)::NUMERIC, 3) AS avg_risk_score FROM transactions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.transaction_id, t.account_id, a.full_name, t.txn_type, t.amount, t.merchant, t.status, t.risk_score, t.location_city, t.is_international, t.device_type, t.created_at FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id WHERE t.risk_score >= 0.70 AND $__timeFilter(t.created_at) ORDER BY t.risk_score DESC LIMIT 50
